section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used in a daily diary study to assess multiple constructs. Body appreciation was measured using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale. The section also details measures for interactions with body-focused others, self-compassion, intuitive eating, body image concerns, and negative affect, all adapted for daily assessment with strong internal consistency across study days. No information about study design, sample characteristics, country, or correlations is provided in this section.
